name: 34900-longdecode-dsv2lite16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off: one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU, no sharding. ~31 GB of weights leaves ~40 GB for the KV pool at 0.90 utilisation.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM: 27 layers, hidden 2048, vocab 102400, 16 query heads, Multi-head Latent Attention (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, qk_nope_head_dim 128, v_head_dim 128), 64-expert MoE MLP with 6 routed plus 2 shared per token and a dense layer 0, YaRN rope, 15.7B params bf16 = ~31 GB; read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 4096 requests / 3600 s safety, warmup 25% and cooldown 10%. A percent warmup resolves to a request count, so it must be at least the stream count to exclude anything: int(0.25 x 4096) = 1024 is exactly the first wave and 0.1 would be inert, leaving ~3072 requests measured. The cooldown is anchored against the safety cap and is not reached on a run of minutes.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 32 tokens and output EXACTLY 1000, min = max on both; `ignore_eos` is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so every request is one 32-token prefill followed by 999 decode steps and the shape cannot drift with the model's stopping behaviour. `temperature: 0.0`, posted to the raw completions endpoint with no chat template. Prompts are Faker-generated English, freshly sampled per request, so nothing is shared between them.
purpose: A long-form story generator for 1,024 concurrent writers, short prompts yielding 1,000-token drafts on one GPU.
launch:
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
kv-cache-dtype: fp8
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-cudagraph-capture-size: 1024
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "PIECEWISE"}
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
